added.summary: A TSX element that draws text reports it in its UI dump's detail as drawn: ink (sRGB 0-255 and alpha 0-1, its opacity included), fontSize and textLines (each laid-out line's box on screen, in CSS px, bounded under a transform). The UI gallery reads each line's ground from its frame and lists text under the screens guide's contrast bar (4.5:1, 3:1 over 24 px) in defects.txt; disabled controls are exempt. The gallery's --only also takes a comma list.
